name: Weetabix with Milk
notes: Weetabix figures are from the label: 3 biscuits (53g) = 180 kcal, 6g protein, 42g carbs, 1g fat, so 60 kcal per biscuit. The milk is estimated: 200ml is a guess at a decent pour, and 2% milk is about 50 kcal, 3.4g protein, 4.9g carbs and 2g fat per 100ml. Each extra 50ml of milk adds about 25 kcal.
